# BoxStation Rules [color=#ffd700]You must be at least 16 years of age to play on BoxStation. Any users suspected of being under 16 years of age will be banned until they are of age.[/color]
- [color=#ff0000]Date last updated:[/color] 28/10/2026 || Rules are updated first on the wiki
BoxStation is a vouch-based whitelist-only MRP+ SS14 server.
Admins will treat you as if you have read and understood the full rules even if you haven't.
If you are unsure of something, AHelp or ask in the admin-questions channel on our discord.
Below is a short form of our rules. Please check the guidebook, our Discord, or our Wiki for more information.
## Community Rules [textlink="Link to the Community Rules" link="CommunityRules"]
[color=#a4885c][bold]0. Catch-All Clause[/bold][/color] Engage with the rules in good faith. Admins have final say.
[color=#a4885c][bold]1. English Speaking Community[/bold][/color] Please speak primarily in English.
[color=#a4885c][bold]2. No Bigotry Allowed[/bold][/color] No hate speech, no slurs, no bigotry. This extends to in-universe behaviour and bigotry, such as speciesism. [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
[color=#a4885c][bold]3. Be Age Appropriate[/bold][/color] BoxStation is a 16+ space. If you are found to be under 16 and playing on the server, you may be removed without warning or ability to appeal. [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
[color=#a4885c][bold]4. Don't Ban Evade[/bold][/color] Do not use alternate discord, ss14, or github accounts. [color=#ff0000](ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY)[/color]
[color=#a4885c][bold]5. Expectations of Privacy[/bold][/color] Do not livestream a round of BoxStation outside of private discord calls. Do not share messages without permission.
[color=#a4885c][bold]6. Maintain a Respectful Environment[/bold][/color] Be nice to each other, be constructive, and always remember the person playing the game.
## Game Rules [textlink="Link to the Game Rules" link="GameRules"]
[color=#a4885c][bold]Game Rule 0[/bold][/color] Certain game rules tagged as "Follows GR0" may be ignored with 2-way consent.
[color=#a4885c][bold]AHelp Relay & Ban Evasion[/bold][/color] Please use the AHelp relay to ask for clarification on any topic, ask the admins to act in their capacity as game masters, or to report rulebreaks or to note offputting behaviour.
[color=#a4885c][bold]No Exploits[/bold][/color] Do not utilize systems or mechanics that are not intended.
[color=#a4885c][bold]No EORG[/bold][/color] Do not engage in antagonistic behaviour or IC crimes after the End Of Round screen has popped up.
[color=#a4885c][bold]SSD Players[/bold][/color] SSD Players are not valid targets for antagonistic behaviour, and should not be disrupted.
[color=#a4885c][bold]Narrative First Gameplay[/bold][/color] Do not Play to Win, Do not Powergame.
[color=#a4885c][bold]No Metacomms[/bold][/color] Do not share current round information. Keep IC information in-character, and OOC information or check-ins in OOC or LOOC.
[color=#a4885c][bold]Game Mastering Expectations[/bold][/color] Shifts only occur when there is an admin presence to facilitate them. Admins are encouraged to unobtrusively support pre-existing narratives, ensure that rounds are able to start, and other such responsibilities.
### Subrule 1 - Roleplay Expectations & Rules [textlink="Link to the Roleplay Rules" link="RoleplayRules"]
[color=#a4885c]RP.0 - Basic Roleplay Expectations[/color] BoxStation is an MPR+ Server. While we do not expect you to be immersed 100% of the time, we expect you to behave IC for the entire duration of a round.
[color=#a4885c]RP.1 - New Life Rule[/color] Don't remember your death. This applies to all deaths but not to sleeping or being in critical condition.
[color=#a4885c]RP.2 - Naming Conventions[/color] Your character must be named in a believable way for an employee of Nanotrasen. Roles that allow you to fill in a secondary name, such as Stage Names or Borg and AI Names, have greater leeway. No names are allowed to be offensive.
[color=#a4885c]RP.3 - Continuity[/color] You are allowed to have continuity between rounds. You do not have to consider any specific round canon, and you must respect another player's decisions on what is not canon to their character.
[color=#a4885c]RP.4 - Play Your Role[/color] When picking a Role to play, you should pick one you are comfortable and willing to play for the entire round. Do not do another player's role.
[color=#a4885c]RP.5 - Reasonable Escalation[/color] You may not kill utilizing Reasonable Escalation. You must still follow the expectations of your role. [bold](Follows GR0)[/bold]
[color=#a4885c]RP.6 - No Self-Antagging[/color] Do not engage in Antagonist behaviours without being an antagonist. [bold](Follows GR0)[/bold]
[color=#a4885c]RP.7 - No Validhunting[/color] As non-security, you should not stop, arrest, hung, or otherwise impede an antagonist's activities, as this is known as Validhunting. [bold](Follows GR0)[/bold]
[color=#a4885c]RP.8 - Cryosleep & Respawning[/color] After entering Cryosleep, you may ask to be sent back to the lobby. Please adhere to the restrictions on what you can and cannot do after returning to the lobby.
[color=#a4885c]RP.9 - Sensitive Topics[/color] You should endeavour to discuss beforehand with someone before engaging in a sensitive topic or heavy topic scene. Do not engage in these topics in Public Spaces or over comms channels.
[color=#a4885c]RP.10 - Social Conflict[/color] You are allowed to play an abrasive character, however you should be careful it remains IC abrasion and does not leak into OOC spaces or behaviours. If a player asks you to reduce or stop being abrasive with them, you must respect this request.
[color=#a4885c]RP.11 - Harmless Crime[/color] You are not exempt from IC consequences from engaging in RP.11 behaviour.
